startCondition: First OnReplay stage UpdateData after Splash fadeout has reached MainMenu. Splash and NowLoading frames are not compared.
endCondition: Last OnReplay stage frame before GameOverMenu. The game-over menu itself is not a required tick.
samplePoint: After PresentState.UpdateData returns, PresentInterval=1. Render, Present and audio callbacks are not required fields. RealTimeTotal is the wall clock and stays in the raw trace.

attribution.capture: sequence, tick-count, anchor or render-field mismatch
attribution.rng-runtime: Framework Random versus net10 Random when the recorded draw tape is absent
attribution.web: candidate logic or patch divergence after rng matches
